walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 4: Unseen — a core area of IGCSE Literature in English.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 4: Unseen brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 4: Unseen.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

Pathetic fallacy is when characters cry over silly things.
Dramatic irony is when characters speak in dramatic voices.
Dramatic irony is when something ironic happens in a play.
